$$

$$

$$

$$

$$
\begin{aligned}X &=\begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 1 \\ -1 & 5 & 4 \\ 2 & 8 & 3\end{bmatrix}\qquad R_{2}:=R_{2} + R_{1} \\ &\sim \begin{bmatrix}1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 3 & 5 \\ 2 & 8 & 3\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the required row operation is

$$
R_{2}:=R_{2} + R_{1}.
$$
